course.name: The Peachy Investor
course.tagline: A futures and stocks trading community for beginners, led by Brittney Marie, built around three structured courses and the Peach Street Trading Discord.
course.about: The Peachy Investor is a trading education community founded by Brittney Marie in 2018, now focused mainly on futures trading. The Peachy Gold membership includes three progressive courses — an introductory overview, a New Trader course covering fundamentals, and a Futures Trader course covering more advanced strategies — plus access to the Peach Street Trading Discord server with daily pre-market plans and trading recaps.

course.testimonials_note: We couldn't reliably access testimonials for this community — Whop's listing pages are JS-rendered and didn't return readable content to us — so none are shown here.

_notes.source: Unusually limited access this time: the likely official domains (thepeachyinvestor.com, peachyinvestor.co, herpeachyinvestor.com, stocks.brittneymarie.com) all failed to load — 404s, DNS failures or connection failures, tried both via fetch and direct curl — so none were usable as a primary source, and 'website' is left null rather than linking something unverified. Built from Whop's own blog review of the product (whop.com/blog/peachy-investor-review), WebSearch results confirming Brittney Marie as founder (est. 2018, ex-personal trainer, 100k+ YouTube subscribers, now focused mainly on futures), and whoptrends.com for pricing/rating/commission, confirmed directly: $167/month, 4.9/5 rating, 273 reviews, 15% affiliate commission. No Trustpilot profile found. No logo found either (Google's favicon service 404s for the one domain it could check, suggesting it's broadly unreachable, not just from here) — a lettermark shows instead. Worth asking for a screenshot of the actual Whop page and/or a working official site link if more detail is wanted.
